description.value: Cafe Overflow is a North Vancouver café blending Korean cuisine with brunch and coffee-shop offerings — an unusual combination that could make it a compelling stop for touring cyclists looking for something beyond standard cafe fare. Its location in North Vancouver places it near popular cycling routes on the North Shore.

address.value: 467 Mountain Hwy #105, North Vancouver, BC V7J 2L3, Canada
